notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: [p][b]⚙️ Performance Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overall, FPS has been increased, and the game now looks better while running more smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the anti-aliasing system from [b]TAA to TSR[/b] – TSR is more demanding, but it significantly reduces ghosting on moving objects and shimmering of distant vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced stuttering during gameplay.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Switched the anti-aliasing system from [b]TAA to TSR[/b] – TSR is more demanding, but it significantly reduces ghosting on moving objects and shimmering of distant vegetation.

notes.title: Localization update
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
Now English, Russian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Portugal/Brazil, Korean, Dutch, Turkish, Japanese, and Polish languages are available in the game!
[h2]Store rating and cleanliness[/h2]
To earn more positive reviews, focus on providing excellent service to your customers. The better your reviews, the higher your store's rating. With a high rating, you can charge more for your products and increase your profits!
[h2]The hand truck was unlocked[/h2]
Have a big delivery? The Hand truck will help you not to carry everything one by one!
[h3]And of course a lot of bug fixing[/h3]
